items.title: Obtain or renew the DeKalb County business license
items.description: DeKalb County's business occupational tax certificate is renewed through the county's online licensing portal (paper or emailed applications are not processed); the 2026 renewal window was January 1 to April 15, with penalties rising after February 1 and April 15. Lodging operators also report hotel/motel excise tax on a separate excise account.

items.title: Obtain or renew the Forsyth County occupational tax certificate
items.description: All businesses operating in unincorporated Forsyth County must hold a current occupational tax certificate (business license). Renewal runs December 1 to March 31 (the county emails a custom renewal form on December 1); renewals received after 5 p.m. on March 31 are late, with a 10% penalty and 1.5% interest a month. New businesses must apply within 30 days of starting and need a Business Location Verification Decision Letter from the county's CSS portal; new applications are by mail or in person, not email.
